title: The Red Ledger
author: Barış Kısır
premise: Forensic auditor Priya Nair finds a red ledger hidden in a bankrupt bank's vault — a second set of books recording payments to a man who died twenty years ago, still being paid. The ledger is alive: every month it grows. Priya must follow the money to its source, even as the source begins following her.
